title: Mahongwe language - Wikipedia
text: The Mahongwe language is a language spoken by the Mahongwe people, belonging to the Bantu ethnic group, who mainly reside in the central Gabon region.The Mahongwe language is part of the Bantuid branch of the Niger-Congo language family.
